1020-2866-6518-8346.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2033-3179-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3179-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Oketra's Monument triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

380-3362-4247.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bladewing.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Resolve all Bloodthrone Vampire abilities.

3899-5058-7422.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature that has Screams from Within attached.
When the creature dies, Screams from Within triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

647-3259-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-3259-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

671-4186-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
671-4186-7743.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

5231-5434-5555-7666.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
5231-5434-5555-7666.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3112-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2104-4823-5144.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Timeless Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-1115-5147-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

1050-7299.description:
Activate Nevinyrral's Disk by paying {1} and tapping it, destroying all artifacts, enchantments and creatures.
Cast Biorhythm by paying its mana cost, causing each player's life total to become equal to the number of creatures they control.
Each player that controls no creatures loses the game due to having 0 life.
1050-7299.notes: You will also lose the game if you control no creatures as Biorhythm resolves, causing the game to end in a draw. You can avoid this by putting a creature onto the battlefield after step 1, or by having an indestructible creature. Similarly, any opponent who controls an indestructible creature will not have 0 life or lose the game.

222-527-2292-4742.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2292-4742.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5147-6730-6972.notablePrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature with base toughness 2 or greater that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5147-6730-6972.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the additional creature.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sin.
When Sin dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Sin from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it. As Sin enters, remove the -1/-1 counter from the creature sacrificed in step 1, causing Sin to enter with a +1/+1 counter on it instead.
Resolve the second Sin trigger, putting the counters it had on it when it was sacrificed onto a creature you control and failing to shuffle it into your library as it's no longer in your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat.

2921-4396-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2921-4396-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

3499-6738-7011-7082.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more Allies.
3499-6738-7011-7082.description:
Cast Razor Boomerang by paying {0} due to Sokka, Swordmaster.
When Razor Boomerang enters, Sokka and Suki's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Sokka and Suki's first ability triggers, attaching Razor Boomerang to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by tapping it and unattaching Razor Boomerang, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning Razor Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

527-4068-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
527-4068-5900.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Selvala.
Repeat.

1385-4681-5170-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

261-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
261-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2034-3875-5478-7090.description:
Activate Ba Sing Se's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, earthbending itself.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ba Sing Se, adding {C}{C}.
When Ba Sing Se dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
When Ba Sing Se enters, Tireless Provisioner triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1734-2511-3817.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from exile to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1651-3263-5640-6858.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Oreskos Sun Guide, targeting Oreskos Sun Guide.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens  abilities, untapping it and Oreskos Sun Guide.
Oreskos Sun Guide triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

49-1878-2713-3454-4539.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
49-1878-2713-3454-4539.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Unexpected Windfall and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Unexpected Windfall, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Soldevi Digger twice by paying {2}, putting Unexpected Windfall and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

1879-4947-5078-6766.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Diving Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Sai triggers, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate the Thopter token by tapping it, adding {U} that can only be spent to cast spells from anywhere except your hand.
Repeat.

4050-4394-5470-5929.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ghired, adding {1}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

280-1479-6528.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
280-1479-6528.description:
Play Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Elfsworn Giant, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

245-1069-1115-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
245-1069-1115-5499.description:
Activate Marneus Calgar by paying {6}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
When the Astartes Warriors enter the battlefield, Marneus Calgar triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to an Astartes Warrior.
Activate the Astartes Warrior with Lotus Ring attached by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 3 for the remaining Astartes Warrior.
Repeat from step 1.

3744-4639-5168.notablePrerequisites: Bloom Tender does not have summoning sickness.
3744-4639-5168.description:
Activate Unctus by paying {U/P}, causing Bloom Tender to become a blue artifact in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}.
Bloom Tender triggers, causing you to loot.
Telekinetic Bonds triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to untap Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control a black, red and/or white permanent, this combo makes near-infinite green mana and/or near-infinite mana of those color(s).

1601-1651-1799-4840-5498.notablePrerequisites:
Grenzo has power 4 or greater.
Illuminor Szeras does not have summoning sickness.
1601-1651-1799-4840-5498.description:
Activate Illuminor Szeras by tapping it and sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, adding seven {B}.
Activate Reito Lantern by paying {3}, putting Myr Battlesphere on the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Myr Battlesphere from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Myr Battlesphere enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Myr Battlesphere and a Myr token, untapping Illuminor Szeras.
Repeat.

2770-3221-3283.description:
Cast Donate by paying {2}{U}, giving control of Notion Thief to an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Consecrated Sphinx triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to draw two cards due to Notion Thief.
Repeat from step 4 until the opponent loses the game due to drawing from an empty library.

1368-3518-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three additional cards between your graveyard and/or hand.
1368-3518-5260.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {U}{U}{U} or {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Breaking from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{B} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Repeat.

4313-4846.notablePrerequisites: Permanents you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
4313-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
 Holding priority, activate all mana-producing permanents you control, adding at least {1}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Flameshadow Conjuring and Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the Flameshadow Conjuring trigger, causing you to pay {R} to create a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The Worldgorger Dragon token enters the battlefield, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Worldgorger Dragon trigger from step 2, exiling all other permanents you control.
The Worldgorger Dragon token leaves the battlefield, causing all permanents you control to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
The nontoken Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering Flameshadow Conjuring and Worldgorger Dragon.
Repeat from step 2.

2259-3356.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Forerunner of the Empire indestructible.
{6}{G}{G}available.
2259-3356.description:
Give Forerunner of the Empire indestructible by any method.
Cast Polyraptor by paying {6}{G}{G}.
Polyraptor enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Empire, causing it to deal 1 damage to each creature.
All Polyraptor creatures trigger.
Resolve one Polyraptor trigger, creating one token copy of Polyraptor.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to deal damage with Forerunner of the Empire triggers and resolving an arbitrarily high number of Polyraptor triggers.
